urgente.consejo: Adjective of a single termination for both genres.

bloques.titulo: The two values of the future
texto: **Valor temporal de posterioridad**: refers to a fact that will happen later: **Domani finiranno il progetto** (tomorrow the project will be completed).
**Valor conjetural o epistemico**: makes a reasonable assumption about an unknown current situation: **Dov'è Paolo? — Sarà ancora in ufficio** (Where is Paolo?) It is probably still in the office.

filas: They will leave for Milan tomorrow for sure.
I guess Lorenzo's in a meeting now.
Che ore sono? — Saranno le tre.

frases.it: Paolo, hai visto Lorenzo? Non risponde al telefono da stamattina.
frases.es: Paolo, ¿has visto a Lorenzo? No responde al teléfono desde esta mañana.
frases.en: Paolo, have you seen Lorenzo? He hasn't been answering the phone since this morning.

frases.it: Sarà ancora in ufficio. Deve finire una relazione urgente.
frases.es: Probablemente todavía está en la oficina. Debe terminar un informe urgente.
frases.en: He's probably still in the office. An urgent report must be completed.
analisis: He's probably still in the office.

frases.it: E quando presenteranno il lavoro ai clienti?
frases.es: ¿Y cuándo presentarán el trabajo a los clientes?
frases.en: And when will they present the work to the customers?

frases.it: Domani finiranno il progetto e venerdì parleranno con il direttore.
frases.es: Mañana terminarán el proyecto y el viernes hablarán con el director.
frases.en: They'll finish the project tomorrow and talk to the director on Friday.
analisis: tomorrow the project will be completed

bloques.pregunta: What does the «Sarà ancora in ufficio» phrase express in the conversation?

opciones.texto: A likely guess or guess about where Lorenzo is now.
opciones.explicacion: The simple future is used here with epistemic value over the present.

opciones.texto: A firm promise that Lorenzo will go to the office tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: Lorenzo is already working at that time according to the assumption.

opciones.texto: A direct order for Lorenzo to remain in his office.
opciones.explicacion: It is not an imperative or a mandatory instruction.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the future of plural conjecture.
bloques.frase: Che ore sono? — Non ho l'orologio, ma ___ le cinque.

opciones.explicacion: With hours in plural («le cinque») the future of thought in plural.
«Sarà» would be used with one («sarà l\'una») or with noon («sarà mezzogiorno»).
It is imperfect and would place the deduction in the past.

bloques.pregunta: What value does the future present here?
bloques.frase: Domani finiranno il progetto e venerdì parleranno con il direttore.

opciones.texto: Posterioridad temporal real fijada en el calendario.
opciones.explicacion: The «domani» and «venerdì» time markers anchor secure future actions.

opciones.texto: Conjecture about what directors do right now.
opciones.explicacion: It is not a current assumption but a future work plan.

opciones.texto: He doubts whether the project was completed last year.
opciones.explicacion: He describes events to come, not past events.

bloques.frase: Domani finiranno il progetto per i clienti
bloques.traduccion: Tomorrow the project will be completed for the customers
bloques.explicacion: Prayer with simple future of regular temporary later.

bloques.pregunta: How would you translate the «Avrà circa quarant'anni» conjecture into Spanish?

opciones.explicacion: The simple Italian future expresses approach or assumption about the present age.

opciones.texto: He'll be 40 next year without fail.
opciones.explicacion: It does not plan a future birthday date but a present estimate.

opciones.texto: I was exactly forty when I met him.
opciones.explicacion: It refers to the age at present.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the future of «essere»'s assumption.
bloques.frase: Lorenzo non risponde perché ___ molto occupato con la nuova relazione.

opciones.explicacion: Third person from singular to deduce the current state of Lorenzo.
It corresponds to the first person of the plural: «We».

bloques.pregunta: What is the expression of the modal verb «dovere» in this context?

opciones.texto: An inescapable obligation or need for work.
opciones.explicacion: «Dovere + infinitivo» expresses the need to complete the report.

opciones.texto: Una capacidad física aprendida mediante entrenamiento.
opciones.explicacion: The capacity learned would be expressed with «sapere».

opciones.texto: A formal permit granted by the management.
opciones.explicacion: The permit would be made with «potere».

intro: The simple future in Italian has two main functions: to place a fact at a later time or to formulate a likely conjecture or deduction on the present.
